value.rationale: Rate tuning is an explicit unstudied design problem identified by existing antisymmetric metapopulation work. The exact unique optimum distinguishes stabilizing exchange from excessively rapid exchange, with both weak and strong coupling producing arbitrarily slow local return. The matched-frequency normalization is a natural parameter slice (reactivation matches intrinsic RPS oscillation), rather than an arbitrary census integer; result is a nontrivial analytic optimization with a sharp physical rate.
